header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: Particular rather than general. Specificity is what makes a claim checkable.
A statement of exactly what a thing must be. A specification is a contract before it is a plan.
How narrowly a thing applies. Greater specificity wins over generality, in style rules and in argument alike.
A continuous range with no steps in it. A spectrum resists the categories laid over it, which is exactly why the word is used of minds.
How much distance is covered in how much time. Speed says nothing about direction.

The seal — the verse where the poet names themselves inside the work, so authorship travels with it. The license as data rather than prose: three grants never one, the copyright never moving, and the seal always evidence, never a lock. Greek joins the naming strata.
A sharp brief rise above the usual. Also a small exploratory build made to learn rather than to keep.
The load-bearing line a body is built around; what everything else attaches to.
A turning mark shown while something is underway. It reports that time is passing, not that progress is being made.
A curve that circles while moving outward or in, never closing. A spiral returns to the same angle at a different depth.
Belonging to what a being holds as meaning beyond the material. Of the layer that cannot be measured and is not therefore absent.
To divide one into parts. A split decides where the seam goes, and the seam is never neutral.
One line from hub to rim — the wheel's supporting ray; and speech's past tense, a word already said.
A unit of the limited energy a body has for a day. Not a metaphor for tiredness — a countable budget that runs out.
A small marked place. Also to notice — the same word for a location and for finding one.
How widely something is distributed. Also to distribute — the same word for the state and the act.
A coil that returns to its shape after being pushed. Also the season of return, and a source of water rising.
The language for asking structured questions of stored data. A named language rather than a concept.
Four equal sides at right angles. Also a public place a town gathers in — both are shapes made by agreement.
Short form of screen reader — the instrument by which a page is heard rather than seen. A named abbreviation.
Short form of source. The written original a built thing was made from.
Irish: a stream, a current — water that carries by flowing. In modern Irish the same root carries live media: sruthú, streaming.
Rendering a page on the server before sending it. It trades some interactivity for arriving already readable.
The tendency to stay as it is under disturbance. Stability is not stillness; it is returning after being pushed.
Things laid one on another, reached from the top. The last placed is the first available.
A step in a sequence, and a raised place where things are shown. Both mean a position passed through and witnessed.
To offset things in time or space so they do not land together. Staggering spreads a load that would otherwise arrive at once.
No longer current, while still appearing so. Staleness is dangerous exactly because it looks like freshness.
A mark pressed on to certify or to date. A stamp says someone attested this.
That which brings differing forms into one agreed shape. Standardising makes comparison possible and costs what was particular.
Upright and in effect — what remains true until changed by the word that made it; a law's, or a lamp's, present state.
A light seen from very far, and a mark meaning notable. Both are things picked out of a field.
To begin. The point before which nothing of this thing existed.
A single measured figure held for comparison. A number lifted out of its context, which is both its use and its danger.
The condition a thing stands in at a given moment. From standing itself - a state is a posture held, not a permanence.
Something asserted plainly and on the record. A statement can be checked, which is what distinguishes it from a remark.
Not changing. Also meaningless noise on a channel — the same word for stillness and for interference.
A fixed place where something is done or where passage stops. A station holds a position in a network.
What can be said about a group that cannot be said about any member of it. Statistics describe sets, never individuals.
Water turned to vapour by heat. Also a named games platform — context decides which.
The part a thing grows from, and the base form a word's variants share. Both are what the rest branches off.
One movement in a sequence of movements. A step assumes a next one, and a place to have come from.

Stereos (Greek στερεός: solid, three-dimensional, firm). The solid as pure number: a polyhedron held as vertices on the unit sphere and faces wound counter-clockwise seen from outside, with the winding made impossible to get wrong — every face whose normal points back toward the centre is reversed at construction, so a back-face cull is honest by shape rather than by careful typing. It holds the five Platonic solids (the dodecahedron derived by duality from the icosahedron, its pentagons ordered around each vertex by angle so they are drawn as pentagons and not as stars), the pentagonal trapezohedron a real ten-sided die actually is — its apex height solved from the condition that each kite be planar, never chosen by eye — the barrel a real three-, five- or seven-sided die is cut as, which declares itself unfair out loud because its side faces are equally likely while the shape is not face-transitive, and the disc, which is a coin and says so, its rim built and lit and never numbered. Beside the shapes stands the light that shows them: one house light so two surfaces can never disagree about where the sun is, an ambient floor generous enough that a face turned away reads as stone in shadow rather than as a hole, a perspective divide that hands back the depth it sorts by, painter's order, Lambertian shade and a Blinn-Phong highlight. The self-check RETURNS its complaints rather than throwing them, because a design system that breaks eighteen apps on import is worse than one that says what is wrong. No colour, no rendering, no DOM, no disk, no clock, zero imports: numbers in, numbers out.
One who tends what belongs to another — counting, filling, submitting, never ruling. Every act signed, every act additive.
Small images placed to mark or decorate. A sticker carries feeling where words would be heavier.
Small notes placed where they will be seen. They hold a thought outside a head so it need not be carried.
How strongly a thing resists being deformed. Stiffness buys precision and costs give.
What arrives and provokes a response. A stimulus is neutral; the response is where the being shows.
Steering, rule, governance — from the steering-oar: the hand on the thing that decides where the whole vessel goes. Old Norse, stjórn. Direction as an act, never as an office.
To cease. A stop is an ending that could have continued, which is what distinguishes it from finishing.
The keeping of things against a later need. Storage assumes retrieval; without it, it is only holding.
A place things are kept until needed, and the keeping itself. Storage assumes a later retrieval.
Events told so that they mean something to whoever hears them. A story is a shape laid over what happened.
One who crosses separate events until they hold as one telling. The weaving is what makes a story out of things that merely happened.
One thread among those twisted into a larger cord. A strand is weak alone and is what the rope is made of.
A plan for reaching an end across many moves. Strategy chooses which battles matter; tactics fight them.
Something arriving continuously rather than all at once. A stream has no total until it stops.
The capacity to bear load without failing. Its root runs through valid, value and valour — all of them mean able to hold.
Load applied to a thing, and the strain of bearing it. Stress is a fact about the relation between a load and a capacity.
To extend beyond the usual bound. A stretch reaches further and returns changed or not at all.
Permitting little deviation. Strictness buys reliability and costs tolerance for the unforeseen.
How little deviation is permitted. Strictness buys reliability and costs tolerance for the unforeseen.
A run of characters treated as one value. Also a thread — the older sense the data one is named from.
A long narrow piece. Also to remove what covers — the same word for a band and for taking away.
A band of one thing laid across another. Also the payment line, named for the mark.
A single line laid down in one motion, and the outline drawn around a shape. Both are one movement made visible.
Belonging to what holds a thing up. Of properties built into the arrangement rather than promised on top of it.
The arrangement that lets a thing hold together and bear load. What remains when the surface is removed.
Sustained effort against resistance. Struggle is not failure; it is what capacity looks like from inside its limit.
A room set aside for making. The place a craft is practised rather than shown.
The manner a thing wears — how it appears without changing what it is. In the house's code, the dress layer; in its prose, the voice.
Under, or below. A part placed at the front to put a thing beneath another.
A named class sitting beneath a broader one. Subcategories are how a taxonomy gains depth without gaining width.
What a thing is about, and the one who acts rather than is acted on. Also one placed under an authority.
A thing handed over for consideration. Also the act of yielding — the same word for offering and for giving way.
To hand a thing over for consideration. Also to yield — the same word for offering and for giving way.
One who has asked to keep receiving. A subscriber consented once and may withdraw at any time.
A standing arrangement renewed over time rather than bought once. Access that continues while payment continues.
Runs taken from within a longer sequence, keeping their order. A subsequence is a selection that respects the original arrangement.
What is meant beneath what is said. Subtext is real and cannot be quoted.
A second line under a title, and text shown for speech. Both carry what the main line alone would not deliver.
Present but only just perceptible. Subtlety is doing the work without announcing it.
Having reached what was aimed at. Also having come after — the same word for achievement and for sequence.
The reaching of what was aimed at. Success is measured against a stated aim, which is why an unstated aim can never be met.

Suchi (Sanskrit sūcī सूची: a needle, and by extension the index — the list that points). A repo that reads itself: its own tree drawn from its own file paths, its own markdown grouped by its own folders, and EACH PAPER'S TITLE TAKEN FROM THE PAPER'S OWN FIRST HEADING — never a string typed beside it, never a lookup table, so a document renamed in its own first line is renamed everywhere at once. A folder becomes a group whose label is derived from the folder name; the repo root sorts first whatever it would do alphabetically. The house's one-line italic gloss under a heading becomes the blurb where it is there and null where it is not — a badge line is not a gloss and neither is a bold one — and a file with no heading at all falls back to its own filename rather than being invented a title or dropped from the index. A paper that declares itself a MIRROR-class self-map is known by the phrase in its own text and never by its filename, so a future self-map inherits the rule by saying so. THE WATER OWNS NEITHER THE BUILD TOOL NOR THE GLOB: it declares the glob's RESULT — path to raw text — as a host surface of one verb and supplies none of it, so the same repo handed over by a build-tool host or a filesystem host or an in-memory fixture yields byte-identical answers. A sūcī points at what is there; it is not the thing, and it holds no copy of the thing.
A Latin square played as a puzzle: each figure appears once in each row, column and box. Japanese, 数独 — short for 数字は独身に限る, "the digits must be single." The constraint is the whole pleasure.
Pain borne over time. Suffering is not the same as pain — it is what pain becomes when it has nowhere to go.
A part placed after a word to change its meaning or class. It carries no meaning alone and alters everything it joins.
To put forward without pressing. A suggestion leaves the decision entirely with the one who hears it.
Something offered without pressing. A suggestion leaves the decision entirely with whoever hears it.
A set of related things offered together. A suite is designed to be used as one, not merely sold as one.
To reduce a whole to its load-bearing parts. Every summary is a claim about what mattered.
The whole reduced to its load-bearing parts. A summary is a claim about what mattered.
The hosted database platform this house keeps its shared knowledge in. A named tool rather than a concept.
Several states held at once, none collapsed into a single answer. Possibility kept open rather than resolved early.
To bear part of a weight so another need not bear all of it. Support does not remove the load; it shares it.
Bearing part of another's weight. Of a thing or a person that makes a load carryable rather than lighter.
The outward face where a thing is met. Everything anyone believes about a system, they learned at its surface.
A looking over the whole in order to measure it. A survey counts and maps; it does not read contents.
Whether a thing can keep going without consuming what it depends on. Sustainability is a question about time, not about virtue.
The framework this house builds its interfaces in. A named tool rather than a concept.
A format describing images as shapes rather than as dots, so they scale without loss. A named format rather than a concept.
Passing across a whole in one continuous motion. A sweep covers everything and examines nothing closely.
To change from one state to another, and the thing that makes the change. Two positions, and nothing between them.
The address book of living lines — where every lamp's number is kept and any voice can be reached.
A mark that stands for something by agreement rather than resemblance. A symbol must be learned; an image need only be seen.
To bring two copies into agreement. Synchronisation must decide, every time, which side wins.
Meaningful coincidence, where events align without one causing the other. The meaning is real to the one who sees it and is not a causal claim.
Brought into agreement across copies or across time. Synchronisation always had to decide which side won.
Where the joined effect exceeds the sum of the separate ones. Synergy must be demonstrated; it is asserted far more often.
The rules by which parts may be joined to make sense. Syntax governs arrangement, not meaning.
The bringing of separate findings into one account holding them all. Synthesis adds the joining, which is real work.
To bring separate findings into one account that holds them all. Synthesis adds the joining, which is real work.
The neon-sunset sound and palette of remembered futures — retro electronic warmth; a theme wearing the glow.
A set of parts whose behaviour together is in none of them alone. A system is what the parts do, not what they are.
A single letter used as a short name or type variable. A fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
A flat surface things are set out on, and the ordered arrangement set out there. First a plank cut for inscribing.
A flat portable surface for reading and writing. The oldest form of the word is a slab of clay.
Parallel surfaces sharing one frame, of which one shows at a time. What is hidden is not gone, only behind.
A label attached so a thing can be found among others. A tag is added by a reader as often as by an author.
One line saying what a thing is for. A tagline is the shortest honest form of a promise.
The wind at one's back — and the utility-class styling system this house's interfaces wear.
To receive into one's hold, or to remove from another's. The same word for accepting and for seizing.
Already held by another. Takenness is a fact about availability, not about worth.
The way — the underlying course things follow when not forced. Named in the Chinese tradition, and defined by resisting definition.
The lightest touch that means something — a fingertip's knock; on screens, the smallest yes.
What an action is aimed at. Naming a target makes it possible to miss.

The cards of the tarot — a deck of seventy-eight, read as a set of pictures a person thinks with. Italian, plural of tarocco; the older Italian game-name, kept whole rather than translated. The meanings are the reader's to make.
A deck whose images are read as a language of archetypes. The cards hold no answers; the reading is where meaning is made.
One bounded piece of work with a done state. A task is defined by being finishable.
A named framework for building desktop applications from web technologies. A named tool rather than a concept.
A share taken by an authority to fund what is held in common. Also any recurring cost a thing imposes.
Belonging to the ordering of kinds by rank. Of the work of saying what a thing sits under.
By the ordering of kinds into ranks. Of a classification that says what a thing sits under.
Several working as one toward a shared end. A team differs from a group by having something it is for.
Belonging to how a thing actually works. Of the layer that must be right whether or not anyone sees it.
To say to another. Also a small sign that gives something away — the same word for speaking and for being read.
One who tells. The teller stands somewhere, and where they stand is part of what is told.
The warmth or coolness a thing carries — the sensory channel of thermal feeling, from ember to frost.
A form prepared for filling — structure decided once so content can be many. The template is the hearth-side of repetition: sameness where sameness serves.
The speed music breathes at — beats walking, running, or resting; time's pace made audible.
Belonging to time. Of what has a when as well as a what.
To care for steadily — the gardener's verb: attention given so a living thing can keep becoming itself.
One who keeps a thing alive by small regular care. In the base, the scripted hands that tend the record itself — never the meaning.
A word's hold on time — when its meaning happens. In grammar, the marker of past, present, or coming.
A word used with a fixed agreed meaning. A term is a word that has been pinned down on purpose.
The surface a system is spoken to in typed text. Also final — the same word for a doorway and for an ending.
A trial made to find out whether something holds. A test does not create soundness; it reveals what was already true.
One who tries a thing in order to find where it fails. The tester's usefulness is measured in problems found, not in approval given.
The line that holds two things in relation without making them one.
A field sized for more than a line. Space given so a longer answer is possible.
How a surface meets the touch — rough, smooth, woven, worn; the sensory channel of feel.
The mark for a table header cell. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
Compared with. The word that introduces the other side of a comparison.
To acknowledge what another gave. Thanks names the giving so it does not pass unmarked.
This particular one, already known to both parties. The word that says we mean a specific thing.
A place made for showing a made thing to those gathered to watch. The watching is part of the work.
A place made for showing a made thing to those gathered to see it. The watching is part of the work.
Belonging to performance before an audience. Of what is shaped by being watched.
Organised by recurring meaning rather than by time or place. Of an ordering that follows what things are about.
The recurring thing that gives a body of work its unity. Also the coherent set of surfaces a system wears.

The appearance of a god to a person — a showing, a manifestation made visible. Greek theophaneia, from theos (god) and phainein (to show). Not the god and not the belief: the moment the unseen takes a face.
The place that is not here — grammar's pointer to elsewhere, and the word that says a thing exists at all.
Of Thetis — sea-goddess and mother, who knew her son's fate and could not change it, in the Greek telling. A named power in this house's pantheon.
How much substance a thing has across its narrowest dimension. What separates a line from a band.
Of small extent across. Thinness lets light and pressure through that thickness would stop.
Whatever can be pointed at and treated as one. The most general noun there is, which is why it is used when nothing narrower fits.
A single strand followed through a larger body. Also a line of conversation held across interruptions.
The line at a doorway, and the level at which something changes. Both are places where crossing matters.
To limit the rate at which something may proceed. Throttling protects what would break under the full flow.
From one side to the other of. Names passage rather than arrival.
How much passes through in a given time. Throughput and latency are different questions and are constantly confused.
A small preview standing for a larger thing. Also the digit that opposes, which is why it means a grip.
One unit of a clock's counting. A tick is the smallest interval a system can tell apart.
A record standing for a claim or a task. A ticket exists so nothing depends on someone remembering.
One level in a stack of levels. A rank that exists only because there are others above or below it.
Part of a named platform's name. A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word.
The dimension along which things happen in order. What lets before and after be told apart.
A span between two moments, held as a value. Duration made arithmetic.
Events laid along time's own axis, ordered as they happened. The record's spatial form — history you can walk.
A limit on how long a wait may last before giving up. A timeout is a decision about patience, made in advance.
A thing that counts a span and reports when it has passed. It watches so nothing else has to.
A mark saying exactly when. A timestamp is what turns an event into a datable fact.
A small offered piece of help, and a sum given beyond what was owed. Both are given freely rather than required.
The name given to a work, and the right of holding a thing. Both are claims made in public.
The handle of this house's second writer, whose poetry page carries it. A name rather than a concept.
Toward a destination. The word that points a motion at its end.
A brief notice that appears, says one thing, and leaves on its own. It asks no answer and blocks nothing.
That which raises brief notices and lets them go on their own. Named for how the message pops up.
Two words run together in this library's own naming, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
